entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
VF-991-74B. Just tell me yes or no, I'm short on time.
I understand. I've pulled up your order. Just so I can process this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They just don't work for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting painful blisters on every ride. I need a refund.
I'm sorry to hear about the blisters; that sounds very uncomfortable. Let me quickly check our return policy against your delivery date. One moment.
Okay, I see here the cycling shoes were delivered 80 days ago. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days, so you are well within the window.
Good. So you're approving the refund?

Yes, absolutely. I have just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email now. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Can I help with anything else?
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
